licence: Article CC BY 4.0 (Frontiers; ledger precedent of the shipped GSE205444 table); GEO/NCBI public repository terms over the deposit

citation.text: Simkovsky R et al. Transcriptomic and Phenomic Investigations Reveal Elements in Biofilm Repression and Formation in the Cyanobacterium Synechococcus elongatus PCC 7942. Front Microbiol 2022;13:899150.

units: weighted and normalized gene fitness on the authors' log2 scale (the weighted average of per-strain log2 count ratios between the fraction and the Time 0 sample, with pseudocounts and per-scaffold normalization, Wetmore et al. 2015), as published in Supplementary File S4

replicates.text: Triplicate bubbling tubes per condition, with the triplicate samples pooled prior to DNA extraction; the deposit publishes one Fitness column per fraction, so the shipped score is that pooled measurement and not a per-replicate value. No replicate count is read off the table's columns.

caveat: Measured in a PCC 7942 RB-TnSeq library, not in UTEX 2973, as a signed gene fitness in a biofilm assay fraction relative to the library at Time 0; the authors' T-values are not carried, and a fitness value is never placed on an expression scale.
